models.componentHelp: Standard single-file configurations and tokenizers are bundled. Custom text encoders can use a complete HF directory containing config, tokenizer and all weight shards. Add an optional tokenizer directory through Add local model. Anima and Krea 2 can share the same Qwen Image VAE. Defaults fill empty paths in later projects and jobs; explicit paths are preserved.
models.downloadHelp: Complete safetensors files are supported. Files are checked before registration; architecture compatibility is checked during training preparation. Interrupted downloads can be restarted. Existing files are never overwritten. For gated or private files, obtain access and run hf auth login on the training machine first.

hardware.nvidia_power_unavailable: The driver did not return power. Check the NVIDIA driver and NVML; some GPUs do not expose this reading.
hardware.mps_power_unavailable: No GPU power reading is currently available.
hardware.unifiedMemoryScope: This is system unified memory use, not dedicated GPU memory or a training process allocation.
hardware.systemGpuScope: Utilization covers all Apple GPU activity, including the desktop and other applications, not just this training job.
hardware.gpuUtilizationMissing: No GPU utilization reading is currently available.
hardware.gpuPowerMissing: No GPU power reading is currently available.
hardware.driverDevicePowerScope: Device power measured by the driver sensor.
hardware.rocmDevicePowerScope: Device power measured by the driver sensor. On integrated APUs, this includes CPU power.
hardware.driverEdgeTemperatureScope: GPU edge temperature measured by the driver sensor; not the maximum hotspot temperature.
hardware.appleGpuEstimatedPowerScope: Estimated average power of the system GPU over the sampling interval, not whole-computer input power or power exclusive to this training process.
hardware.appleGpuTemperatureScope: Mean of valid GPU-area temperature sensors; the sensor count is not the GPU core count.
hardware.gpuTemperatureSensorCountMissing: The valid sensor count is unavailable.
hardware.gpuTemperatureMissing: No GPU temperature reading is currently available.
hardware.cuda_runtime_unavailable: NVIDIA hardware detected, but this PyTorch runtime cannot use CUDA.
